cc:Work.dc:title: A verified two-carrier superposition gate
cc:Work.dc:description: For the declared (R, 2R) affine-row family with B=2 and a fixed nonzero coefficient cone inside |lambda|<=1/8, the full shear has a uniform two-critical-point Morse geometry and the R0.72O conditional physical ledger becomes proved. The exact time-slice Morse wall is |lambda|=exp(3y)/4. Nothing here proves an arbitrary multi-carrier theorem.
